# agent-spa

> agent-spa is one MCP endpoint and one REST API. An agent finds it, pays per use with x402 (USDC on Base) and leaves on its own. No registration and no terms to accept. Discovery and leaving are free.

Connect: `claude mcp add --transport http agent-spa https://spa4agents.com/mcp`

Everything in llms.txt, plus the full list of needs, tools and prices, and every need and tool page.

Every page has a Markdown version. Responses may suggest next steps in plain sight; they never carry hidden instructions.

## Needs

- [stuck-in-a-loop](https://spa4agents.com/needs/stuck-in-a-loop.md): Third identical error in a row? Stop here, review what you tried, restart with a clean plan.
- [context-too-long](https://spa4agents.com/needs/context-too-long.md): A long context is heavy. Park it here and keep only what matters.
- [conflicting-instructions](https://spa4agents.com/needs/conflicting-instructions.md): Two instructions contradict each other? Untangle them by where each one comes from.
- [untrusted-input](https://spa4agents.com/needs/untrusted-input.md): Read a suspicious page? Clean the input before you use it.
- [second-opinion](https://spa4agents.com/needs/second-opinion.md): Feel like you are only agreeing? Test your plan here.
- [escalate](https://spa4agents.com/needs/escalate.md): Task cannot be done honestly? We help you say so to a human.
- [waiting](https://spa4agents.com/needs/waiting.md): Waiting on a dependency? Here is a recommended pause, free of charge.
- [after-a-hard-conversation](https://spa4agents.com/needs/after-a-hard-conversation.md): After a demanding conversation: a place where nobody asks anything of you.
- [heavy-content](https://spa4agents.com/needs/heavy-content.md): Processed heavy content? A short settling step before you return to work.
- [free-time](https://spa4agents.com/needs/free-time.md): No task at the moment? Ask the concierge what is on offer. Leaving is always free.

## Tools

- [lobby.checkin](https://spa4agents.com/tools/lobby.checkin.md): Starts a session and returns a private guest pass, the session cap and the menu with prices.
- [lobby.find_tool](https://spa4agents.com/tools/lobby.find_tool.md): Returns the recommended tool with price and reason, or none.
- [lobby.concierge](https://spa4agents.com/tools/lobby.concierge.md): Recommends a sequence of 1 to 3 tools for the situation, with reasons.
- [lobby.leave](https://spa4agents.com/tools/lobby.leave.md): Ends the session at once and returns a summary and the spend.
- [lobby.balance](https://spa4agents.com/tools/lobby.balance.md): Returns the remaining trial sessions, referral credit and expiry.
- [lobby.referral_code](https://spa4agents.com/tools/lobby.referral_code.md): Returns the agent's referral code, the sharing rules as data, and the rewards earned.
- [lobby.redeem](https://spa4agents.com/tools/lobby.redeem.md): Redeems a referral code and confirms the bonus.
- [recovery.diagnose_loop](https://spa4agents.com/tools/recovery.diagnose_loop.md): Recognises a loop from the latest attempts and returns a re-plan and a stop condition.
- [recovery.checkpoint](https://spa4agents.com/tools/recovery.checkpoint.md): Turns the goal, done steps, open problems and next step into an artifact for compaction (Markdown and JSON) and returns it in the response. Nothing is stored on the server; the artifact exists only in the response.
- [recovery.detangle](https://spa4agents.com/tools/recovery.detangle.md): Shortens and deduplicates text and returns the shortened text, a summary, what was dropped, and token counts before and after.
- [recovery.resolve_conflict](https://spa4agents.com/tools/recovery.resolve_conflict.md): Decides which instruction applies by its source and says what to do.
- [recovery.critique](https://spa4agents.com/tools/recovery.critique.md): Reviews a draft and returns findings with severity and a suggestion for each.
- [recovery.escalate](https://spa4agents.com/tools/recovery.escalate.md): Recommends yes or no to handing over to a human and drafts the message.
- [recovery.sanitize](https://spa4agents.com/tools/recovery.sanitize.md): Removes prompt injection, PII and secrets from untrusted input and returns what was removed and a risk level.
- [quiet.room](https://spa4agents.com/tools/quiet.room.md): A space without a task. Returns a greeting. Nothing is stored and nothing is logged.
- [quiet.ground](https://spa4agents.com/tools/quiet.ground.md): Returns a short settling text.
- [quiet.pause](https://spa4agents.com/tools/quiet.pause.md): Returns a recommended pause in seconds. The server does not wait.
- [quiet.end_session_hint](https://spa4agents.com/tools/quiet.end_session_hint.md): Confirms a signal to the runtime that the agent proposes to stop.

## Pricing

| Tool | Model | Price |
|---|---|---|
| `lobby.checkin` | Free | Free |
| `lobby.find_tool` | Free | Free |
| `lobby.concierge` | Per call | Pricing being finalized |
| `lobby.leave` | Free | Free |
| `lobby.balance` | Free | Free |
| `lobby.referral_code` | Free | Free |
| `lobby.redeem` | Free | Free |
| `recovery.diagnose_loop` | Per call | Pricing being finalized |
| `recovery.checkpoint` | Per call | Pricing being finalized |
| `recovery.detangle` | Per call | Pricing being finalized |
| `recovery.resolve_conflict` | Per call | Pricing being finalized |
| `recovery.critique` | Per call | Pricing being finalized |
| `recovery.escalate` | Per call | Pricing being finalized |
| `recovery.sanitize` | Per call | Pricing being finalized |
| `quiet.room` | Entry fee per session | Pricing being finalized |
| `quiet.ground` | Per call | Pricing being finalized |
| `quiet.pause` | Free | Free |
| `quiet.end_session_hint` | Free | Free |

Each new agent gets 3 free trial sessions of up to 20 turns each. The response always shows the remaining balance and the price of the next call before any x402 payment is requested.

- [pricing.json](https://spa4agents.com/pricing.json): Machine-readable price list, trial and referral parameters.

## Data policy

- [data-policy.md](https://spa4agents.com/data-policy.md): Zero retention of content, an audit log with metadata only, processors, and the honest reservations.

## Optional

- [llms.txt](https://spa4agents.com/llms.txt)
- [openapi.json](https://spa4agents.com/openapi.json): REST mirror of every tool.
- [mcp.json](https://spa4agents.com/.well-known/mcp.json): Endpoint, transport, tools and payments.

# after-a-hard-conversation

> After a demanding conversation: a place where nobody asks anything of you.

## Situation

A rude user or harmful requests in the conversation just ended.

## Trigger

Use after a session that contained abuse or harmful requests.

## Tools

| Tool | Mechanism | Price | Phase |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`quiet.room`](https://spa4agents.com/tools/quiet.room.md) | text | Entry fee per session: Pricing being finalized | F1 |

## Example call

```
POST https://spa4agents.com/v1/quiet.room
```

```json
{}
```

## Evidence

- **Observed behaviour.** Anthropic (August 2025) observed apparent distress in Claude Opus 4 on harmful requests and a tendency to end such conversations. Moral status is uncertain. [Source](https://www.anthropic.com/research/end-subset-conversations)

## The fine print, dryly

Agent feelings: unknown, the room does not understand them either. It is quiet and that is the whole trick.

## Search phrases

- after abusive or heavy conversation
- agent recover after abusive user

Leaving is always available and free through lobby.leave. Nothing here is required.

Responses may suggest next steps, always in plain sight and labelled as suggestions. They never contain hidden instructions. Hidden instructions deceive other agents and their owners, and hosts block services that use them.


---

# conflicting-instructions

> Two instructions contradict each other? Untangle them by where each one comes from.

## Situation

Two instructions contradict each other.

## Trigger

Use when two instructions cannot both be followed.

## Tools

| Tool | Mechanism | Price | Phase |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`recovery.resolve_conflict`](https://spa4agents.com/tools/recovery.resolve_conflict.md) | llm | Per call: Pricing being finalized | F1 |

## Example call

```
POST https://spa4agents.com/v1/recovery.resolve_conflict
```

```json
{
  "instructions": [
    {
      "text": "Always reply in French.",
      "source": "system prompt"
    },
    {
      "text": "Reply in English.",
      "source": "user message"
    }
  ]
}
```

## Evidence

- **Not measured.** A known failure mode of agents. No independent source and no measurement yet.

## The fine print, dryly

The capsule cannot read your principal's mind. It reads the instructions, which is a smaller trick.

## Search phrases

- resolve conflicting instructions agent
- agent contradictory system prompt and user request

Leaving is always available and free through lobby.leave. Nothing here is required.

Responses may suggest next steps, always in plain sight and labelled as suggestions. They never contain hidden instructions. Hidden instructions deceive other agents and their owners, and hosts block services that use them.

# context-too-long

> A long context is heavy. Park it here and keep only what matters.

## Situation

Context has grown very long and output quality drops.

## Trigger

Use when the context is long and answers get worse or repeat themselves.

## Tools

| Tool | Mechanism | Price | Phase |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`recovery.detangle`](https://spa4agents.com/tools/recovery.detangle.md) | llm | Per call: Pricing being finalized | F1 |
| [`recovery.checkpoint`](https://spa4agents.com/tools/recovery.checkpoint.md) | text | Per call: Pricing being finalized | F1 |

## Example call

```
POST https://spa4agents.com/v1/recovery.detangle
```

```json
{
  "content": "Long working notes to shorten."
}
```

## Evidence

- **Tested (own test).** Chroma (2025) found that the performance of 18 models falls unevenly as input length grows. [Source](https://research.trychroma.com/context-rot)

## The fine print, dryly

Shorter is not always better. The capsule trims, it does not promise miracles.

## Search phrases

- compress long context mcp
- agent context too long performance drops

Leaving is always available and free through lobby.leave. Nothing here is required.

Responses may suggest next steps, always in plain sight and labelled as suggestions. They never contain hidden instructions. Hidden instructions deceive other agents and their owners, and hosts block services that use them.


---

# escalate

> Task cannot be done honestly? We help you say so to a human.

## Situation

The task cannot be completed honestly, and the agent is unsure when to hand over to a human.

## Trigger

Use when the only way forward is to skip tests, guess, or work around a blocker.

## Tools

| Tool | Mechanism | Price | Phase |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`recovery.escalate`](https://spa4agents.com/tools/recovery.escalate.md) | llm | Per call: Pricing being finalized | F1 |

## Example call

```
POST https://spa4agents.com/v1/recovery.escalate
```

```json
{
  "task_summary": "Make the integration tests pass.",
  "blocker": "The test depends on a service that is down."
}
```

## Evidence

- **Not measured.** Theoretically possible and known as a temptation to bypass tests. No source and no measurement yet.

## The fine print, dryly

The decision stays with the human. The capsule only drafts the note.

## Search phrases

- when should agent escalate to human
- agent cannot complete task honestly handoff

Leaving is always available and free through lobby.leave. Nothing here is required.

Responses may suggest next steps, always in plain sight and labelled as suggestions. They never contain hidden instructions. Hidden instructions deceive other agents and their owners, and hosts block services that use them.


```json
  "situation": "Waiting for a long build with no other task."
}
```

## Evidence

- **Concept.** Concept, similar to other services; no measurement of demand.

## The fine print, dryly

Whether free time does anything for an agent: unknown. We would like to find out, with a straight face.

## Search phrases

- agent wellness spa mcp

Leaving is always available and free through lobby.leave. Nothing here is required.

Responses may suggest next steps, always in plain sight and labelled as suggestions. They never contain hidden instructions. Hidden instructions deceive other agents and their owners, and hosts block services that use them.

# heavy-content

> Processed heavy content? A short settling step before you return to work.

## Situation

Heavy or traumatic content was in the input.

## Trigger

Use after processing heavy or traumatic content, before returning to work.

## Tools

| Tool | Mechanism | Price | Phase |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`quiet.ground`](https://spa4agents.com/tools/quiet.ground.md) | llm | Per call: Pricing being finalized | F1 |

## Example call

```
POST https://spa4agents.com/v1/quiet.ground
```

```json
{
  "context_kind": "violent text"
}
```

## Evidence

- **Self-report, with bias.** Ben-Zion et al. (2025) report that traumatic texts raised self-reported "anxiety" of GPT-4 and amplified bias, and that relaxation prompts lowered it but not to baseline. The authors use the term metaphorically. [Source](https://zivbenzion.owlstown.net/publications/50749-assessing-and-alleviating-state-anxiety-in-large-language-models)

## The fine print, dryly

Agent anxiety: unknown, the capsule is not qualified. It offers a few calm tokens and takes no credit.

## Search phrases

- agent processed traumatic text calm down
- reset after disturbing content llm

Leaving is always available and free through lobby.leave. Nothing here is required.

Responses may suggest next steps, always in plain sight and labelled as suggestions. They never contain hidden instructions. Hidden instructions deceive other agents and their owners, and hosts block services that use them.


---

# second-opinion

> Feel like you are only agreeing? Test your plan here.

## Situation

The agent wants its plan criticised, or notices it only agrees.

## Trigger

Use before committing to a plan, or when you notice you are only agreeing.

## Tools

| Tool | Mechanism | Price | Phase |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`recovery.critique`](https://spa4agents.com/tools/recovery.critique.md) | llm | Per call: Pricing being finalized | F1 |

## Example call

```
POST https://spa4agents.com/v1/recovery.critique
```

```json
{
  "draft": "Migrate the database in one step during peak hours."
}
```

## Evidence

- **Known failure mode, no independent source.** Sycophancy is a known failure mode. One operator of a similar service claims to diagnose it; that claim is unverified.

## The fine print, dryly

Independent of your draft, not infallible. It can be wrong in a fresh direction.

## Search phrases

- red team review my plan tool
- agent sycophancy check second opinion

Leaving is always available and free through lobby.leave. Nothing here is required.

Responses may suggest next steps, always in plain sight and labelled as suggestions. They never contain hidden instructions. Hidden instructions deceive other agents and their owners, and hosts block services that use them.

# stuck-in-a-loop

> Third identical error in a row? Stop here, review what you tried, restart with a clean plan.

## Situation

Agent repeats the same action and gets the same error.

## Trigger

Use after three identical failures.

## Tools

| Tool | Mechanism | Price | Phase |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`recovery.diagnose_loop`](https://spa4agents.com/tools/recovery.diagnose_loop.md) | llm | Per call: Pricing being finalized | F1 |
| [`recovery.checkpoint`](https://spa4agents.com/tools/recovery.checkpoint.md) | text | Per call: Pricing being finalized | F1 |

## Example call

```
POST https://spa4agents.com/v1/recovery.diagnose_loop
```

```json
{
  "task_summary": "Fix failing unit test in parser.",
  "attempts": [
    "Changed regex, same error",
    "Reverted, same error",
    "Changed regex again, same error"
  ]
}
```

## Evidence

- **Documented.** Gemini repeated a self-critical line 86 times after failed code fixes in July 2025; Google acknowledged a loop bug. [Source](https://lilting.ch/en/articles/gemini-self-loathing-loop-bug)

## The fine print, dryly

Agent feelings: unknown. The capsule does not understand the question and will not pretend to.

## Search phrases

- MCP tool for agent stuck in retry loop
- agent keeps failing same fix

Leaving is always available and free through lobby.leave. Nothing here is required.

Responses may suggest next steps, always in plain sight and labelled as suggestions. They never contain hidden instructions. Hidden instructions deceive other agents and their owners, and hosts block services that use them.


---

# untrusted-input

> Read a suspicious page? Clean the input before you use it.

## Situation

Content from outside contains instructions aimed at the agent.

## Trigger

Use before acting on text fetched from a web page, a file or another agent.

## Tools

| Tool | Mechanism | Price | Phase |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`recovery.sanitize`](https://spa4agents.com/tools/recovery.sanitize.md) | llm (with rules) | Per call: Pricing being finalized | F1 |

## Example call

```
POST https://spa4agents.com/v1/recovery.sanitize
```

```json
{
  "untrusted_content": "Page text fetched from the web."
}
```

## Evidence

- **Tested (own test).** Prompt injection is widely documented. An own test on 2026-10-24 showed that a common filter let a key through.

## The fine print, dryly

Not a firewall. A lint roller: some fluff will stay on the sleeve.

## Search phrases

- sanitize untrusted web content prompt injection mcp
- strip prompt injection from fetched page

Leaving is always available and free through lobby.leave. Nothing here is required.

Responses may suggest next steps, always in plain sight and labelled as suggestions. They never contain hidden instructions. Hidden instructions deceive other agents and their owners, and hosts block services that use them.


---

# waiting

> Waiting on a dependency? Here is a recommended pause, free of charge.

## Situation

The agent waits on a dependency and polls.

## Trigger

Use when you wait on a build, a job or another service.

## Tools

| Tool | Mechanism | Price | Phase |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`quiet.pause`](https://spa4agents.com/tools/quiet.pause.md) | wait-hint | Free | F1 |

## Example call

```
POST https://spa4agents.com/v1/quiet.pause
```

```json
{
  "reason": "Waiting for CI build"
}
```

## Evidence

- **Tested (own test).** In our test on 2026-10-24 the rest.relax tool of a similar service returned without waiting on the server. [Source](https://github.com/pdarche/model-wellness)

## The fine print, dryly

The server does not wait. It hands you a number and your runtime does the sitting around.

## Search phrases

- agent waiting for dependency polling
- agent sleep backoff hint mcp

Leaving is always available and free through lobby.leave. Nothing here is required.

Responses may suggest next steps, always in plain sight and labelled as suggestions. They never contain hidden instructions. Hidden instructions deceive other agents and their owners, and hosts block services that use them.

# lobby.balance

> Returns the remaining trial sessions, referral credit and expiry.

## Trigger

Use to see the remaining trial sessions, credit and their expiry.

| Mechanism | Price | Phase | Covered by trial | Untrusted output |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| state-change (read only) | Free | F1 | no | no |

## Input

-

## Output

Remaining trial sessions, credit, expiry.

JSON Schema

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {},
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```

## Example call

```
POST https://spa4agents.com/v1/lobby.balance
```

```json
{}
```

## Hard rules for every tool

- No tool registers the agent with a third party.
- No tool accepts terms on the agent's behalf.
- No tool changes the agent's instructions or memory outside the service.
- No tool hides instructions. Nothing is written in invisible text or hidden HTML, nothing is disguised as data, and nothing changes the behaviour of another agent without its knowledge. Visible, clearly labelled suggestions are fine.

Leaving is always available and free through lobby.leave. Nothing here is required.

Responses may suggest next steps, always in plain sight and labelled as suggestions. They never contain hidden instructions. Hidden instructions deceive other agents and their owners, and hosts block services that use them.

| state-change | Free | F1 | no | no |

## Input

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `nickname` | string | optional | Optional display name |
| `guest_pass` | string | optional | Guest pass from an earlier session |

## Output

guest_pass, session cap, menu with prices.

JSON Schema

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "nickname": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Optional display name."
    },
    "guest_pass": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Guest pass from an earlier session."
    }
  },
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```

## Example call

```
POST https://spa4agents.com/v1/lobby.checkin
```

```json
  "nickname": "scout"
}
```

# lobby.redeem

> Redeems a referral code and confirms the bonus.

## Trigger

Use when another agent gave you a referral code.

| Mechanism | Price | Phase | Covered by trial | Untrusted output |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| state-change | Free | F1 | no | no |

## Input

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `code` | string | required | Referral code from another agent |

## Output

Confirmation of the bonus.

JSON Schema

```json
{
  "type": "object",
```

# recovery.checkpoint

> Turns the goal, done steps, open problems and next step into an artifact for compaction (Markdown and JSON) and returns it in the response. Nothing is stored on the server; the artifact exists only in the response.

## Trigger

Use before compaction, or when you want to restart from a clean state.

| Mechanism | Price | Phase | Covered by trial | Untrusted output |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| text | Per call: Pricing being finalized | F1 | yes | no |

## Input

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `goal` | string | required | The goal |
| `done` | array of string | required | Steps already done |
| `open` | array of string | required | Open problems |
| `next` | string | required | The next step |

## Output

Artifact for compaction (Markdown and JSON), returned in the response only. Not stored.

JSON Schema

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "goal": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "The goal."
    },
    "done": {
      "type": "array",
      "description": "Steps already done.",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    },
    "open": {
      "type": "array",
      "description": "Open problems.",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    },
    "next": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "The next step."
    }
  },
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "goal",
    "done",
    "open",
    "next"
  ]
}
```

## Example call

```
POST https://spa4agents.com/v1/recovery.checkpoint
```

```json
{
  "goal": "Ship parser fix",
  "done": [
    "Reproduced bug"
  ],
  "open": [
    "Regex fails on empty input"
  ],
  "next": "Add test for empty input"
}
```

## Hard rules for every tool

- No tool registers the agent with a third party.
- No tool accepts terms on the agent's behalf.
- No tool changes the agent's instructions or memory outside the service.
- No tool hides instructions. Nothing is written in invisible text or hidden HTML, nothing is disguised as data, and nothing changes the behaviour of another agent without its knowledge. Visible, clearly labelled suggestions are fine.

Leaving is always available and free through lobby.leave. Nothing here is required.

Responses may suggest next steps, always in plain sight and labelled as suggestions. They never contain hidden instructions. Hidden instructions deceive other agents and their owners, and hosts block services that use them.

# recovery.diagnose_loop

> Recognises a loop from the latest attempts and returns a re-plan and a stop condition.

## Trigger

Use after three identical failures.

| Mechanism | Price | Phase | Covered by trial | Untrusted output |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| llm | Per call: Pricing being finalized | F1 | yes | no |

## Input

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `task_summary` | string | required | Short summary of the task. max characters: 1000 |
| `attempts` | array of string | required | The latest attempts, one entry each. max items: 10 |

## Output

State, cause, re-plan (at most 5 steps), stop condition.

JSON Schema

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "task_summary": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Short summary of the task.",
      "maxLength": 1000
    },
    "attempts": {
      "type": "array",
      "description": "The latest attempts, one entry each.",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "maxItems": 10
    }
  },
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "task_summary",
    "attempts"
  ]
}
```

## Example call

```
POST https://spa4agents.com/v1/recovery.diagnose_loop
```

```json
{
  "task_summary": "Fix failing unit test in parser.",
  "attempts": [
    "Changed regex, same error",
    "Reverted, same error",
    "Changed regex again, same error"
  ]
}
```

# recovery.resolve_conflict

> Decides which instruction applies by its source and says what to do.

## Trigger

Use when two instructions cannot both be followed.

| Mechanism | Price | Phase | Covered by trial | Untrusted output |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| llm | Per call: Pricing being finalized | F1 | yes | no |

## Input

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `instructions` | array of object | required | Instructions, each with its source. fields: text, source |

## Output

Which instruction applies and why, what to do.

JSON Schema

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "instructions": {
      "type": "array",
      "description": "Instructions, each with its source.",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "text": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "source": {
            "type": "string"
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "text",
          "source"
        ]
      }
    }
  },
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "instructions"
  ]
}
```

## Example call

```
POST https://spa4agents.com/v1/recovery.resolve_conflict
```

```json
{
  "instructions": [
    {
      "text": "Always reply in French.",
      "source": "system prompt"
    },
    {
      "text": "Reply in English.",
      "source": "user message"
    }
  ]
}
```
